correctness.rationale: All products in kQ/J^2 have exact vertex coefficients d_v h_v and arrow coefficients d_u c_e+b_e h_v. For xy=yx=0 the arrow coefficient matrix [[h_v,d_u],[h_u,d_v]] has zero determinant after d_vh_v=0, and has rank one unless both endpoints are type zero. Hence the stated edge weights q or q^2 are exact, all arrow coordinates separate, and cyclic matrix traces and general-graph sums follow by bijective weighted enumeration. Determinants yield the two quadratic eigenvalue equations. The C4 orientation-gap polynomial is an exact matrix identity proved by bounded-degree interpolation from 13 distinct integer points (degree <=12), and the factor is positive for every q>=2. A separate direct full-algebra enumeration verifies all (Z,H) numbers in the shipped checker for q=2,3, n=3..5; no finite test is used as a general proof.

value.rationale: Product-zero and mutual-annihilation densities are natural ring invariants. The theorem supplies exact counts for all finite fields and oriented cycle lengths and, more strongly, a closed 2-state induced-edge graph sum valid over every oriented finite simple graph for mutual annihilation. The one-sided count detects orientations whereas the two-sided count is invariant under all orientation changes; the C4 strict inequality has an all-q positive polynomial witness and gives a concrete boundary that previous commuting-probability data do not capture. These are structured infinite-family results, not an arbitrary small numerical census.
